content_data.project_description: Development of a real-time telemetry data processing system to enhance UX insights from connected vehicles across European markets. The platform will enable predictive analytics and personalized driver experience optimization.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1 (months 1-4) for architecture design, Phase 2 (months 5-10) for core development, and Phase 3 (months 11-14) for testing and deployment
objectives: Establish GDPR-compliant data pipelines for European automotive clients
Build scalable microservices architecture to process 50M+ telemetry events daily from connected vehicles
deliverables: Real-time analytics dashboard with customizable UX metrics
Technical architecture documentation and deployment runbooks
resources_needed: Cloud infrastructure budget for AWS services including EKS, MSK, and RDS
Performance testing tools and monitoring platform subscriptions
2 DevOps engineers with Kubernetes and AWS expertise
